content: I found it - the correct type is `Spreadsheet::Sheet`. Let me now create the spreadsheet with material/measurement information for the Body:

function.arguments:
{"script": "python3 << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open('/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd')

# Find the Body object
body = None
for obj in doc.Objects:
    if obj.Name == 'Body':
        body = obj
        break

if not body:
    print("Body not found!")
else:
    # Create the spreadsheet
    sheet = doc.addObject('Spreadsheet::Sheet', 'Body_Spreadsheet')
    print(f"Created spreadsheet: {sheet.Name}")
    
    # Get shape properties from the Body
    # The Body's Tip property points to the last feature, we need the actual shape
    tip = body.Tip
    if tip and hasattr(tip, 'Shape'):
        shape = tip.Shape
    else:
        shape = body.Shape
    
    # Get volume and bounding box
    volume = shape.Volume
    bbox = shape.BoundBox
    
    # Calculate surface area by iterating through faces
    surface_area = 0.0
    if hasattr(shape, 'Faces'):
        for face in shape.Faces:
            surface_area += face.SurfaceArea
    
    # Get center of mass
    try:
        com = shape.CenterOfMass
    except:
        com = (0, 0, 0)
    
    # Set spreadsheet cells with measurements
    # A1: Property name, B1: Value
    sheet.set('A1', 'Property')
    sheet.set('B1', 'Value')
    sheet.set('A2', 'Volume')
    sheet.set('B2', str(volume))
    sheet.set('A3', 'Surface Area')
    sheet.set('B3', str(surface_area))
    sheet.set('A4', 'X Length')
    sheet.set('B4', str(bbox.XLength))
    sheet.set('A5', 'Y Length')
    sheet.set('B5', str(bbox.YLength))
    sheet.set('A6', 'Z Length')
    sheet.set('B6', str(bbox.ZLength))
    sheet.set('A7', 'Center of Mass X')
    sheet.set('B7', str(com[0]))
    sheet.set('A8', 'Center of Mass Y')
    sheet.set('B8', str(com[1]))
    sheet.set('A9', 'Center of Mass Z')
    sheet.set('B9', str(com[2]))
    
    # Recompute the document
    doc.recompute()
    
    # Verify the spreadsheet was created
    print("\nSpreadsheet contents:")
    for cell in ['A1', 'B1', 'A2', 'B2', 'A3', 'B3', 'A4', 'B4', 'A5', 'B5', 'A6', 'B6', 'A7', 'B7', 'A8', 'B8', 'A9', 'B9']:
        val = sheet.get(cell)
        print(f"  {cell}: {val}")
    
    # Save the document
    doc.saveAs('/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd')
    print("\nDocument saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

EOF"}

    # Get shape properties from the Body
    # The Body's Tip property points to the last feature, we need the actual shape
    tip = body.Tip
    if tip and hasattr(tip, 'Shape'):
        shape = tip.Shape
    else:
        shape = body.Shape
    
    # Get volume and bounding box
    volume = shape.Volume
    bbox = shape.BoundBox
    
    # Calculate surface area - use Shape.SurfaceArea directly on the compound
    try:
        surface_area = shape.SurfaceArea
    except AttributeError:
        # For compound shapes, sum up face areas
        surface_area = 0.0
        for face in shape.Faces:
            # Use area property of face
            surface_area += face.Area
    
    # Get center of mass
    try:
        com = shape.CenterOfMass
    except:
        com = (0, 0, 0)
    
    # Set spreadsheet cells with measurements
    # A1: Property name, B1: Value
    sheet.set('A1', 'Property')
    sheet.set('B1', 'Value')
    sheet.set('A2', 'Volume')
    sheet.set('B2', str(volume))
    sheet.set('A3', 'Surface Area')
    sheet.set('B3', str(surface_area))
    sheet.set('A4', 'X Length')
    sheet.set('B4', str(bbox.XLength))
    sheet.set('A5', 'Y Length')
    sheet.set('B5', str(bbox.YLength))
    sheet.set('A6', 'Z Length')
    sheet.set('B6', str(bbox.ZLength))
    sheet.set('A7', 'Center of Mass X')
    sheet.set('B7', str(com[0]))
    sheet.set('A8', 'Center of Mass Y')
    sheet.set('B8', str(com[1]))
    sheet.set('A9', 'Center of Mass Z')
    sheet.set('B9', str(com[2]))
    
    # Recompute the document
    doc.recompute()
    
    # Verify the spreadsheet was created
    print("\nSpreadsheet contents:")
    for cell in ['A1', 'B1', 'A2', 'B2', 'A3', 'B3', 'A4', 'B4', 'A5', 'B5', 'A6', 'B6', 'A7', 'B7', 'A8', 'B8', 'A9', 'B9']:
        val = sheet.get(cell)
        print(f"  {cell}: {val}")
    
    # Save the document
    doc.saveAs('/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd')
    print("\nDocument saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

EOF"}
